text:
alex: hey team, found an old AWS access key in a partner debug export (redacted). key id AKIAOLDXXXX. looks tied to svc-backup-cron. not in Vault. probable leak.
mira: yikes. can you paste the log lines (no creds) and the s3 path?
alex: GET s3://partner-archive/2021/backup-archive.tar.gz from 18.204.12.7, user-agent: svc-backup-cron, Authorization header present (redacted).
devin: treat this as a secret-exposure incident. immediate containment: mark key Inactive in AWS and rotate any live consumers.
tasha: I'll disable it now and create a limited role for the cronjob to assume. also planning IRSA mapping.
cloud-bot: Running: aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIAOLDXXXX --status Inactive --user-name svc-backup-cron (simulated)
tasha: done. key status set to Inactive.
alex: Thanks. Can we verify there were no API calls with that key recently?
devin: kicking off CloudTrail lookup for AccessKeyId=AKIAOLDXXXX across all regions.
cloud-bot: CloudTrail query q-7782 started. ETA ~40s.
devin: result: last recorded use 2021-11-20. no recent activity. probably historical key. still consider remediated.
mira: next steps: 1) create Vault secret at secret/data/infra/legacy/svc-backup-cron 2) create policy limiting read to that path 3) provision STS role + IRSA for the cronjob 4) sweep repos for hard-coded creds 5) re-encrypt S3 objects to a CMK we control 6) enable audit+alerts for vault read anomalies.
nate: I can add an alert: Vault path read rate threshold = 2/day -> page ops. Also anomaly detection for reads from uncommon IP ranges.
alex: KMS question: partner objects are encrypted with aws-managed key. Do we recommend a customer-managed CMK and rewrap?
mira: yes. create CMK with a narrow key policy: allow Encrypt/Decrypt only to the new role and backup SREs. plan a rewrap job that reads and writes objects under the new CMK during low-traffic window.
tasha: I'm provisioning the Vault kv and policy now. sample put command: ```vault kv put secret/infra/legacy/svc-backup-cron access_key=<NEW_ACCESS_KEY> secret_key=<NEW_SECRET_KEY>```
devin: also remove any kube secrets that embed AWS creds. run `git grep -n "AKIA" || true` across infra repos. I'll open PRs if I find inline keys.
nate: ops note: schedule KMS rotation and rewrap during 0200-0500 UTC to avoid impacting backups. add rate limit to rewrap job to avoid S3 throttling.
vault-bot: Ticket SEC-2411 created: "legacy svc-backup-cron IAM key found in partner export - containment & rotation". assignee: tasha. status: open.
tasha: ETA for full containment (Vault + IRSA + repo sweep + rewrap) = 36 hours. I'll post updates in the ticket.
mira: please capture who had access to the original key in the IAM audit and remove any long-lived IAM user credentials. also add an RBAC check in the k8s cluster: ensure serviceAccount tokens are not used to store static creds.
devin: PRs opened: infra/cron#74, storage/rewrite#210. tagging @backup-team for confirmation of no remaining usage.
ate: adding SOC rule: alert on vault read of secret/infra/legacy/* from outside corp IP ranges. retention of audit logs set to 1 year for that path.
alex: checklist for close: - key disabled (done) - CloudTrail lookup (done) - Vault secret + policy (in progress) - IRSA + role (in progress) - repo sweep (in progress) - rewrap to CMK (planned) - alerts + audit retention (in progress) - post-incident review + writeup (pending)
tasha: I'll update SEC-2411 with timestamps, CloudTrail artifacts, and PR links. moving heavy logs to the ticket and keeping this thread for coordination.
cloud-bot: Reminder: create a short-lived STS role for the job and expire long-lived credentials as part of the cleanup.
mira: good work everyone. keep the thread concise. we'll run a short retro after the ticket is resolved. :lock:
